FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Hawkish Fed and Lower Deficit Support Bounce Toward MA20
tldr_points: US August budget deficit beats expectations, boosting USD
Fed hike outlook for Sep/Dec per JPMorgan adds hawkish pressure
Technical oversold RSI with price below MA20 suggests short-term bounce
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY poised to test MA20 as Fed hawkishness and lower deficit outweigh oil-driven JPY pressure.
FX.comment: Fundamental tailwinds from Fed hawkishness and lower deficit combined with technical oversold bounce toward MA20.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] FLAT: MA20 Reclaim Required as Yield Pressure Offsets Tech Leadership
tldr_points: Price is 21.73 points, or 0.283%, below MA20, while RSI-14 at 49.03 signals balanced momentum.
Technology and Communication Services support index resilience, but higher shorter-maturity yields limit valuation upside.
Use a 7,690.00 breakout entry, 7,765.00 target, and 7,635.00 stop; remain flat without confirmation.
STOCKS.excerpt: Neutral below 7,690: sub-MA20 price and RSI 49.03 offset tech-led strength as CPI-driven yields cap expansion risk.
STOCKS.comment: Price remains below MA20 with neutral RSI, warranting a conditional breakout trade rather than immediate directional exposure.

Steady inflation outlook keeps Fed rates unchanged, supporting risk‑on sentiment.
Key resistance at MA20 (~78,600) offers upside target; stop below recent swing low.
